'''Geenor''' was a farmer on the planet [[Ceriun]] about [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. He was an associate of [[Flass]] and [[Tenno]] who together worked on the fields to collect [[dung weed]]. Hoping a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] would discover them and train them, they waited until a [[Unidentified tattooed Sith|Sith]] came and slaughtered the group.
